tools.name: search_drinks
tools.description: Search and filter the PEWES ENERGY catalogue. Returns a page of drinks with slug, name, price per can in EUR, stock, range, sugar, taste and caffeine options.

tools.name: get_drink
tools.description: Everything the store publishes about one drink, as Markdown: facts, price, caffeine options, description and the page to buy it from.

tools.name: get_price_list
tools.description: The price list as Markdown: price per can, the volume pricing ladder, the subscription discount and reseller terms.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Any public storefront page as Markdown, by path: /, /shop, /shop/<range>, /shop/<range>/<slug>, /about, /subscribe, /faq, /blog, /blog/<slug>, /become-a-reseller.
